re man+ta'i gtor 'bul ni/dkar gtor gtsang ma bran la a kā ros byin gyis brlabs nas/hūm̐/rdo rje khro bo re man+ta/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog 'dra

tei:div.tei:p: dkar gtor gtsang ma bran la a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐/ rdo rje khro bo re man+ta// gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog 'dra zhing*/ khro 'dzum bzhad cing sgeg pa'i gzugs// dbu la dngul gyi rmog zhu la// bya phod dkar pos brgyan pa gsol// dmar ljang dar ber 'bar ba'i steng*// bse khrab mi zhub rta zhub mnabs// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga phyar// g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin// mdung dar dmar po gru na bcug /chibs su sngon po chu ris 'chib// sngon po sgab ser rol du khrid// spyi bo'i gtsug na bya khyung lding*// phrag gong lcags kyi bya khra 'jum// seng chen gnyis ni phyi na 'gying*// rgya stag gnyis ni mdun nas 'gro// rang 'dra lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rngog chags 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// tshe srog brtan pa'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ 'jig rten tshangs pa'i mgon po ni// kun da'i mdog can khro zhing bzhad// dar nag ber gsol g.yu 'brug 'chib// phyag na 'khor lo zhags pa bsnams// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rta nad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ dpal ldan ār+ya re man+ta// btso ma gser gyi kha dog can// gzhon nu nyi ma'i sras po ni// pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog can// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rta g.yang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// hūm̐/ ma hā kā la re man+ta// sprul pa khyung gis nam mkha' gang*// lcags kyi bya khras bar snang gang*// stag dang seng ges sa gzhi gang*// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rta la gnod byed rdul du rlogs// hūm̐/ srid gsum dbang sgyur gang ba bzang*// sems dpa' rdo rje rnam thos sras// nor lha bye ba 'bum dang bcas// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rngog chags srung zhing skyob pa dang*// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/

lha chen ma hā kā la ni// rta nag rting dkar chibs su 'chib// nyi zla skar chen 'od zer 'phro// stong gsum gling bzhi yud kyis nyul// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rta 'dre rtil sri tshar gcod cig /hūm̐// gnod sbyin rta bdag ku be ra// rang 'dra sprul pa 'bum dang bcas// ral gri phyar zhing gnod byed 'dul// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// gzhi byes lam gsum gar 'dug kyang*// rta yi rdzi bo ma g.yel cig /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma gtsang sar phul// cho ga rgyas pa ma lcogs na gtor 'bul kho nas chog /ces pa rta gzungs cho ga'i kha skong du rig sngags 'dzin pa rā ga a s+yas bris pa'o// 'di bris nyes pa rta lha'i tshogs la bshags shing dge bas bkra shis bde legs 'byung gyur cig// /
